people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.
translations.bsb: a rebellion against Moses, along with 250 men of Israel renowned as leaders of the congregation and representatives in the assembly.
translations.kjv: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
